capabilities: Lists graph color groups with node counts
Highlights or isolates the notes of a group
Creates color groups from folders, tags or a property
Saves and applies named sets of color groups
extras: Makes no network requests; reads .obsidian/graph.json every two seconds to pick up outside changes and writes only the color groups. Relies on undocumented graph internals, so highlighting switches itself off if a future Obsidian version changes them; tested with Obsidian 1.15.0.
intentEvidence: Lists the graph's color groups in a small legend, with how many nodes each one colors.
problem: The graph view colors notes by group but shows no legend, so you cannot tell which group a color stands for or how many notes it covers.

relations.evidence: If an AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and others) adds color groups to your vault

summary: Legend panel for the graph view that lists color groups with node counts and lets you highlight, search, reorder, recolor and save them.
